title: Live dashboard sync: in-sidecar WS watcher
description: Add an opt-in (DASH_SYNC) isolated WS task in snapshot.py that subscribes to HA state_changed + entity_registry_updated, debounces, and re-pushes the Cameras dashboard via lovelace/config/save only when the camera roster/online-split signature changes. Extract pure discover/build logic into root cameras_dashboard.py shared by the CLI and the sidecar. Reuses admin HA_TOKEN; separate connection; full state_changed firehose with client-side camera filter (no narrowing).

title: Add deploy/build_cameras_dashboard.py (WS dashboard pusher)
description: Standalone Python script: auto-discover camera.wyze_<key>_snapshot tiles + live state via HA REST /api/states, then create/update a storage-mode 'Cameras' dashboard (url_path wyze-cameras) in the HA sidebar over WebSocket using admin HA_TOKEN. Mirrors cameras-dashboard.yaml layout. Pure config-builder unit-tested. README subsection.
